Buildman build tool
===================

Buildman builds U-Boot for many boards and commits at once, and summarises
the results, such as the warnings, errors and changes in code size which each
commit introduces.

Buildman is maintained as a separate project, at
https://github.com/deinde-dev/buildman, and is installed as the buildman
package::

    pip install buildman

Its documentation is at https://buildman.readthedocs.io/
